name: pi-early-compact
description: Standalone Pi extension: deterministic, configurable early compaction (adaptive window tiers, percentage/token thresholds, warning margin). Composable with pi-vcc but never dependent on it.

scripts.check: deno check --sloppy-imports --node-modules-dir=none src/index.ts tests/*.ts && deno run --allow-all --sloppy-imports --node-modules-dir=none scripts/check-complexity.ts
